messages:
maya: Quick preflight — putting together a concise GA readiness checklist for the SDK + hosting launch. Focus areas: SLA targets, docs + onboarding, oncall/support, monitoring/SLOs, pricing & billing thresholds. Need owners and any hard blockers.
sam: Love it. Can you drop the suggested SLA numbers? that'll help sales/legal sign-off.
maya: Suggestion: 99.95% uptime SLA for hosted API, p99 latency target <= 200ms for 512-token requests, error budget 0.05% monthly. Fallback policy: auto-route to compatible lower-cost model if error budget exhausted.
eli: p99 200ms is aggressive for mixed workloads. Can we qualify that to "for latency-sensitive routes" and have a separate best-effort bucket for large-seq? Otherwise ops will cry.
nina: Agreed with eli. Proposal: two SLA classes — "latency" (p99 <=200ms for seq<=512) and "throughput" (median latency target + throughput guarantees). Document in SLA annex.
chris: On docs: SDK quickstart needs a 2-min example, plus a troubleshooting runbook for the 3 common errors (auth, quota, deploy mismatch). I'll own the SDK doc PR if someone gives me the code snippet.
maya: @chris assigning you SDK quickstart + error-runbook. @eli you take infra runbooks (oncall playbooks + rollback). @nina you draft SLA annex text. @sam you coordinate pricing commit and legal review.
sam: I'll sync with finance on the pricing tiers. Q: Should we ship reserved capacity pricing at GA or beta it later?
maya: We need reserved pricing at GA — many pilot customers ask for committed capacity. Offer 3 tiers: small/medium/large with commit discounts. But mark quotas as "beta" in console until 2nd week post-GA.
eli: On monitoring: dashboards we need = 1) latency SLO heatmap, 2) error-rate by model & route, 3) quota burn & billing spikes, 4) canary health. I can build 1+2 this week.
nina: Also add a regression alert that ties to our evals set. If generation quality drops >5% on the eval set, page oncall and kick off rollback/mitigation.
chris: For support: 24x5 L1 via chat at GA, with L2 engineers on-call weekdays 9-5, and on-call rotation for nights/weekends for P1s only. Need oncall rota and runbook finalized.
maya: I'll compile oncall rota template. @eli please verify oncall paging thresholds and runbook steps (what we page for, who owns what).
eli: Will do. Also recommend a brief "canary gating" checklist: smoke tests, load profile, model quality spot-check.
deploy-bot: Canary started: product-ga-canary-1719510200 — 50rps baseline, routes A/B.
sam: Pricing doc question — do we expose per-token + per-embedding lines, or unify under single "unit" in billing UI?
maya: Keep both lines visible in billing UI, but allow an "aggregated view" for customers who prefer one number. Also pre-seed billing examples in docs.
chris: I'll add the sample billing CSV and CLI export to the docs PR.
maya: Timelines: finish drafts by EOD Fri, runbook + dashboards ready by Mon EOD, legal/pricing sign-off by Tue. Can we hit GA gate in 2 weeks if all green?
eli: Feasible if no infra surprises. Flagging potential blocker: quantization model variant compatibility for fallback path — need validation tests.
nina: I'll add a note in the SLA annex about model-variant fallbacks and expected quality delta.
maya: Thanks all. I'll assemble the single checklist doc and ping for sign-offs — dropping an initial PR link in this thread shortly.
chris: 👍
sam: 👍 on timelines. I'll start the finance review today.
maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/452 — contains SLA draft, doc checklist, pricing matrix, and owners.
eli: skimming PR now, will comment on the canary test config.
deploy-bot: Canary update: healthy 5m window, latency within expected bands for route A.
maya: Great — keep updates here. If anyone sees a showstopper, call it out now so we can adjust dates.
sam: No blockers from my side yet. Finance needs one more SKU clarification but that's small.
nina: Draft SLA annex done, leaving TODOs where legal input is required.
maya: Perfect. Closing the thread in 48h if no new blockers. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
